scope: parking (parking, stopping and standing a vehicle, and where each is not allowed)

vocabulary.definition: The person operating a motor vehicle.
To leave a vehicle stopped, occupied or not, other than a temporary stop to obey signs, signals or traffic.
To allow a vehicle to stand, including standing idling, occupied or not, other than a temporary stop to obey signs, signals or traffic.
To bring the vehicle to a halt, even momentarily.
The width between the boundary lines of a publicly maintained way any part of which is open to the public for vehicular travel.
A pedestrian crossing area, such as one indicated by white crosswalk lines painted across a road.
A parking space designated as disabled parking, reserved for vehicles carrying individuals with disabilities.
Parking with the vehicle lined up parallel to and going the same direction as the curb, 6 to 18 inches from the curb.

rules.title: Secure the vehicle when leaving it
rules.when: leaving the vehicle
rules.action: turn the motor off, set the parking brake and remove the key
rules.statement: WHEN leaving the vehicle, the DRIVER MUST turn the motor off, set the parking brake and remove the key.

rules.title: Look behind before opening the door
rules.when: the vehicle is parked AND the DRIVER is about to open a car door
rules.action: look behind for any oncoming traffic before opening the door
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is parked AND the DRIVER is about to open a car door, the DRIVER MUST look behind for any oncoming traffic before opening the door.

rules.title: Unattended vehicle: set the brake
rules.when: leaving the vehicle unattended
rules.action: permit the vehicle to STAND without setting the brake
rules.statement: WHEN leaving the vehicle unattended, the DRIVER MUST NOT permit the vehicle to STAND without setting the brake.
rules.note: Stated as illegal. The remote-starter exception in 8.43 covers only the engine, ignition and key requirements, not the brake.

rules.title: Unattended vehicle: engine off, ignition locked, key removed
rules.when: leaving the vehicle unattended
rules.action: permit the vehicle to STAND idling without turning off the engine, locking the ignition and removing the key from the ignition
rules.unless: the engine was started with a remote starter or similar device that starts the engine without the key in the ignition
rules.statement: WHEN leaving the vehicle unattended, the DRIVER MUST NOT permit the vehicle to STAND idling without turning off the engine, locking the ignition and removing the key from the ignition, UNLESS the engine was started with a remote starter or similar device that starts the engine without the key in the ignition.

vague_terms.explanation: which devices qualify is not listed

rules.note: Stated as illegal.

rules.title: Remotely started vehicle: key before operating
rules.when: the engine was started remotely without the key in the ignition AND the DRIVER is about to operate the vehicle
rules.action: have the key placed in the ignition or physically present in the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN the engine was started remotely without the key in the ignition AND the DRIVER is about to operate the vehicle, the DRIVER MUST have the key placed in the ignition or physically present in the vehicle.

rules.title: No double parking
rules.when: on the road side of any vehicle stopped or parked at the edge or curb of a street
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.unless: the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals
rules.statement: WHEN on the road side of any vehicle stopped or parked at the edge or curb of a street, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle, UNLESS the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals.
rules.note: The list is introduced with 'you should not', under the heading 'Do Not Park, Stop, or Stand a Vehicle'; the stronger heading wording is recorded.

rules.title: Not on a sidewalk or crosswalk
rules.when: on a sidewalk or CROSSWALK
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.unless: the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals
rules.statement: WHEN on a sidewalk or CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle, UNLESS the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals.
rules.note: The list is introduced with 'you should not', under the heading 'Do Not Park, Stop, or Stand a Vehicle'; the stronger heading wording is recorded.

rules.title: Not within an intersection
rules.when: within an intersection
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.unless: the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals
rules.statement: WHEN within an intersection, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle, UNLESS the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals.
rules.note: The list is introduced with 'you should not', under the heading 'Do Not Park, Stop, or Stand a Vehicle'; the stronger heading wording is recorded.

rules.title: Not at a safety zone
rules.when: between a safety zone and the adjacent curb OR within 30 feet of a place on the curb immediately opposite the end of a safety zone
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.unless: the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals
rules.statement: WHEN between a safety zone and the adjacent curb OR within 30 feet of a place on the curb immediately opposite the end of a safety zone, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle, UNLESS the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals.

vague_terms.explanation: term not defined in the handbook

rules.note: The list is introduced with 'you should not', under the heading 'Do Not Park, Stop, or Stand a Vehicle'; the stronger heading wording is recorded.

rules.title: Not alongside an excavation or obstruction
rules.when: alongside or opposite any street excavation or obstruction AND stopping, standing or parking there would obstruct traffic
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.unless: the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals
rules.statement: WHEN alongside or opposite any street excavation or obstruction AND stopping, standing or parking there would obstruct traffic, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle, UNLESS the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals.
rules.note: The list is introduced with 'you should not', under the heading 'Do Not Park, Stop, or Stand a Vehicle'; the stronger heading wording is recorded.

rules.title: Not on a bridge, elevated structure or in a tunnel
rules.when: on a bridge or other elevated structure on a HIGHWAY OR within a HIGHWAY tunnel
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.unless: the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals
rules.statement: WHEN on a bridge or other elevated structure on a HIGHWAY OR within a HIGHWAY tunnel, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle, UNLESS the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals.
rules.note: The list is introduced with 'you should not', under the heading 'Do Not Park, Stop, or Stand a Vehicle'; the stronger heading wording is recorded.

rules.title: Never on railroad or light rail tracks
rules.when: on any railroad or light rail track
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN on any railroad or light rail track, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle.
rules.note: Stated in three places: the do-not-stop list (8.10), 'Never stop on the tracks' (5.49), and the light rail table, which says stopping or parking on the tracks is 'dangerous and illegal' (10.171); the strongest wording is recorded.

rules.title: Sign prohibits stopping
rules.when: at any place where an official sign prohibits stopping
rules.action: STOP, PARK or STAND the vehicle
rules.unless: the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals
rules.statement: WHEN at any place where an official sign prohibits stopping, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP, PARK or STAND the vehicle, UNLESS the DRIVER is stopping temporarily to obey signs or signals.
rules.note: Regulatory sign, so recorded as REQUIREMENT.

rules.title: Emergency stopping only shoulder
rules.when: an EMERGENCY STOPPING ONLY sign designates the shoulder of the road
rules.action: STOP on that shoulder
rules.unless: the vehicle is required to stop because of mechanical breakdown, tire trouble, lack of fuel or other emergencies
rules.statement: WHEN an EMERGENCY STOPPING ONLY sign designates the shoulder of the road, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP on that shoulder, UNLESS the vehicle is required to stop because of mechanical breakdown, tire trouble, lack of fuel or other emergencies.

vague_terms.explanation: which other situations count is not listed

rules.note: Regulatory sign.

rules.title: Not in front of a driveway
rules.when: in front of a public or private driveway
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN in front of a public or private driveway, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: 15 feet from a fire hydrant
rules.when: within 15 feet of a fire hydrant
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN within 15 feet of a fire hydrant, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: 20 feet from a crosswalk at an intersection
rules.when: within 20 feet of a CROSSWALK at an intersection
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN within 20 feet of a CROSSWALK at an intersection, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: 30 feet before a roadside signal or sign
rules.when: within 30 feet upon the approach to any flashing signal, stop sign, yield sign or other traffic control signal located at the side of a road
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN within 30 feet upon the approach to any flashing signal, stop sign, yield sign or other traffic control signal located at the side of a road, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: Near a fire station entrance
rules.when: within 20 feet of the driveway entrance to any fire station OR on the side of a street opposite the entrance to any fire station within 75 feet of the entrance
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN within 20 feet of the driveway entrance to any fire station OR on the side of a street opposite the entrance to any fire station within 75 feet of the entrance, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: Sign prohibits parking or standing
rules.when: at any place where an official sign prohibits parking or standing
rules.action: PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN at any place where an official sign prohibits parking or standing, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or STAND the vehicle, whether occupied or not.
rules.note: Regulatory sign, so recorded as REQUIREMENT.

rules.title: 50 feet from a railroad crossing
rules.when: within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad crossing
rules.action: PARK the vehicle, whether occupied or not
rules.statement: WHEN within 50 feet of the nearest rail of a railroad crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle, whether occupied or not.

rules.title: Sign prohibits parking
rules.when: at any place where an official sign prohibits parking
rules.action: PARK the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN at any place where an official sign prohibits parking, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK the vehicle.
rules.note: Regulatory sign, so recorded as REQUIREMENT.

rules.title: Not on a street where a fire truck answered an alarm
rules.when: a fire truck has answered an alarm on a street
rules.action: drive or PARK on that street
rules.statement: WHEN a fire truck has answered an alarm on a street, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive or PARK on that street.

rules.title: Do not block an ambulance
rules.when: near the scene of an emergency
rules.action: PARK in a location that interferes with the arrival or departure of an ambulance to or from the scene
rules.statement: WHEN near the scene of an emergency, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK in a location that interferes with the arrival or departure of an ambulance to or from the scene.

rules.title: Park off the road outside business or residential districts
rules.when: on a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district AND it is possible to park off the road
rules.action: PARK or leave the vehicle to STAND on the paved part of the HIGHWAY
rules.statement: WHEN on a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district AND it is possible to park off the road, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK or leave the vehicle to STAND on the paved part of the HIGHWAY.

rules.title: On the pavement: leave room to pass
rules.when: the vehicle is parked on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district because it cannot be parked off the road
rules.action: leave plenty of room for others to pass
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is parked on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district because it cannot be parked off the road, the DRIVER MUST leave plenty of room for others to pass.

rules.title: On the pavement: visible for 200 feet
rules.when: the vehicle is parked on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district because it cannot be parked off the road
rules.action: make sure the vehicle can be seen for at least 200 feet from each direction
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is parked on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district because it cannot be parked off the road, the DRIVER MUST make sure the vehicle can be seen for at least 200 feet from each direction.

rules.title: On the pavement at night: lights on
rules.when: the vehicle is parked on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district because it cannot be parked off the road AND it is night
rules.action: use the parking lights or leave the headlights on dim
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is parked on the paved part of a HIGHWAY outside a business or residential district because it cannot be parked off the road AND it is night, the DRIVER MUST use the parking lights or leave the headlights on dim.

rules.title: Parked on an unlighted highway at night
rules.when: the vehicle is parked on an unlighted HIGHWAY at night
rules.action: leave the parking lights or low beam headlights on
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is parked on an unlighted HIGHWAY at night, the DRIVER MUST leave the parking lights or low beam headlights on.

rules.title: Disabled parking space
rules.when: at a DISABLED PARKING SPACE
rules.action: PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle in the space
rules.unless: the vehicle has a disabled license plate or a state-issued disabled parking windshield identification card
rules.statement: WHEN at a DISABLED PARKING SPACE, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK, STOP or STAND the vehicle in the space, UNLESS the vehicle has a disabled license plate or a state-issued disabled parking windshield identification card.
rules.penalty: Misdemeanor: fine of $500 to $750 for a first offense, rising to up to $1,250 for five or more offenses; additional offenses include community service.
rules.note: 8.31 states the prohibition without the exception; 8.33 and the RESERVED PARKING sign description (6.122) give the plate/card exception. 8.38 says only certain municipalities also prohibit stopping or standing; see PARK-DIS-02.

rules.title: Municipal ban on stopping or standing in disabled spaces
rules.when: at a DISABLED PARKING SPACE in a municipality that prohibits stopping or standing there
rules.action: STOP or STAND the vehicle in the space
rules.unless: a disabled parking windshield identification card is visible OR the vehicle has a disabled license plate
rules.statement: WHEN at a DISABLED PARKING SPACE in a municipality that prohibits stopping or standing there, the DRIVER MUST NOT STOP or STAND the vehicle in the space, UNLESS a disabled parking windshield identification card is visible OR the vehicle has a disabled license plate.

vague_terms.term: a municipality that prohibits stopping or standing there

rules.title: Windshield card only when transporting its holder
rules.when: parking with a disabled parking windshield identification card
rules.action: use the card
rules.unless: the DRIVER is transporting the disabled person to whom it was issued
rules.statement: WHEN parking with a disabled parking windshield identification card, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the card, UNLESS the DRIVER is transporting the disabled person to whom it was issued.

rules.title: Do not block an access or curb ramp
rules.when: parking, stopping or standing near an access or curb ramp
rules.action: block the access or curb ramp
rules.statement: WHEN parking, stopping or standing near an access or curb ramp, the DRIVER MUST NOT block the access or curb ramp.

rules.title: Not in striped wheelchair-lift areas
rules.when: at a striped area adjacent to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE OR a striped area in front of a business entrance adjacent to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE
rules.action: PARK in the striped area
rules.statement: WHEN at a striped area adjacent to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE OR a striped area in front of a business entrance adjacent to a DISABLED PARKING SPACE, the DRIVER MUST NOT PARK in the striped area.
rules.note: Reason given: striped areas are for wheelchair lifts. The diagrams show hatched areas beside and in front of spaces marked with the wheelchair symbol.

rules.title: Parallel parking: choose space and position
rules.when: PARALLEL PARKING
rules.action: choose a space large enough for the car, then signal and stop even with the front of the car ahead about two feet out from the space
rules.statement: WHEN PARALLEL PARKING, the DRIVER MUST choose a space large enough for the car, then signal and stop even with the front of the car ahead about two feet out from the space.

rules.title: Parallel parking: signal before passing the spot
rules.when: approaching a spot to PARALLEL PARK in
rules.action: signal before passing the spot, to alert drivers behind
rules.statement: WHEN approaching a spot to PARALLEL PARK in, the DRIVER MUST signal before passing the spot, to alert drivers behind.

rules.title: Parallel parking: back in with wheels turned right
rules.when: PARALLEL PARKING AND stopped beside the car ahead of the space
rules.action: make sure the vehicle will not interfere with oncoming traffic, then turn the front wheels all the way to the right and back slowly toward the curb
rules.statement: WHEN PARALLEL PARKING AND stopped beside the car ahead of the space, the DRIVER MUST make sure the vehicle will not interfere with oncoming traffic, then turn the front wheels all the way to the right and back slowly toward the curb.

rules.title: Parallel parking: turn left and back without touching
rules.when: PARALLEL PARKING AND the front seat is opposite the rear bumper of the car ahead
rules.action: turn the steering wheel all the way to the left and back slowly toward the car behind without touching it
rules.statement: WHEN PARALLEL PARKING AND the front seat is opposite the rear bumper of the car ahead, the DRIVER MUST turn the steering wheel all the way to the left and back slowly toward the car behind without touching it.

rules.title: Within 18 inches of the curb
rules.when: PARALLEL PARKING on a roadway that allows two-way traffic
rules.action: park with the vehicle's right-hand wheels within 18 inches of the right-hand curb or edge of the roadway
rules.statement: WHEN PARALLEL PARKING on a roadway that allows two-way traffic, the DRIVER MUST park with the vehicle's right-hand wheels within 18 inches of the right-hand curb or edge of the roadway.
rules.note: 8.49 also says do not park more than 18 inches from the curb or edge of the road; the glossary (16.109) says 6 to 18 inches.

rules.title: About six inches from the curb
rules.when: PARALLEL PARKING
rules.action: end up about six inches from the curb
rules.statement: WHEN PARALLEL PARKING, the DRIVER SHOULD end up about six inches from the curb.

rules.title: Straighten and center
rules.when: PARALLEL PARKING AND the vehicle has backed into the space
rules.action: straighten the front wheels, pull into the final parking position and center the car in the space
rules.statement: WHEN PARALLEL PARKING AND the vehicle has backed into the space, the DRIVER MUST straighten the front wheels, pull into the final parking position and center the car in the space.

rules.title: Unattended on a grade: turn wheels
rules.when: leaving the vehicle unattended on any grade
rules.action: turn the front wheels to the curb or side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN leaving the vehicle unattended on any grade, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels to the curb or side of the road.
rules.note: Stated as illegal not to.

rules.title: Uphill with a curb
rules.when: parking facing uphill next to a curb
rules.action: turn the back of the front wheels to the curb
rules.statement: WHEN parking facing uphill next to a curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the back of the front wheels to the curb.
rules.note: Rests on a diagram: arrow pointing up the page with a curb on the right and front wheels turned away from it, captioned 'Turn back of wheels to curb'. The uphill reading is inferred from the arrow.

rules.title: Downhill with a curb
rules.when: parking facing downhill next to a curb
rules.action: turn the front wheels to the curb
rules.statement: WHEN parking facing downhill next to a curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels to the curb.
rules.note: Rests on a diagram: arrow pointing down the page, curb beside the car and wheels turned toward it, captioned 'Turn wheels to curb'. The downhill reading is inferred from the arrow.

rules.title: Uphill without a curb
rules.when: parking facing uphill where there is no curb
rules.action: turn the front wheels to the right
rules.statement: WHEN parking facing uphill where there is no curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels to the right.
rules.note: Rests on a diagram: arrow pointing up the page, rough road edge without curb and wheels turned right, captioned 'Turn wheels to right no curb'. The uphill reading is inferred from the arrow; 18.5 asks about parking uphill without a curb.

rules.title: Leaving a space: check mirrors for pedestrians and children
rules.when: leaving any parking space
rules.action: use caution and check all mirrors to make sure nothing, especially pedestrians or children, is obstructing the vehicle's path
rules.statement: WHEN leaving any parking space, the DRIVER MUST use caution and check all mirrors to make sure nothing, especially pedestrians or children, is obstructing the vehicle's path.
rules.note: Reason given: children often play between parked cars; the figure caption says to watch for children in residential areas.

rules.title: Look back when backing out
rules.when: backing out of a parking space
rules.action: look back before and while backing up
rules.statement: WHEN backing out of a parking space, the DRIVER MUST look back before and while backing up.

rules.title: Signal when leaving a parking space
rules.when: leaving a parking space, including pulling away from a parking space parallel to the curb
rules.action: signal to notify other drivers
rules.statement: WHEN leaving a parking space, including pulling away from a parking space parallel to the curb, the DRIVER MUST signal to notify other drivers.
rules.note: Stated in Chapter 7 ('Be sure to use your signal') and Chapter 6 ('Always signal when ... pull away from a parking space parallel to the curb').

rules.title: Stopped by law enforcement: where to park
rules.when: stopped by law enforcement
rules.action: slow down and park as far to the right of the main traffic lane as possible, on the right shoulder if available, or otherwise on a nearby well-lighted side street or parking lot away from high volume traffic
rules.statement: WHEN stopped by law enforcement, the DRIVER SHOULD slow down and park as far to the right of the main traffic lane as possible, on the right shoulder if available, or otherwise on a nearby well-lighted side street or parking lot away from high volume traffic.
rules.note: Introduced as 'it is suggested'.

rules.title: Stopped by law enforcement: secure the vehicle
rules.when: stopped by law enforcement AND the vehicle has been pulled over
rules.action: place the vehicle in a parking position, set the emergency brake, turn the engine off and activate the hazard warning lights
rules.statement: WHEN stopped by law enforcement AND the vehicle has been pulled over, the DRIVER SHOULD place the vehicle in a parking position, set the emergency brake, turn the engine off and activate the hazard warning lights.
rules.note: Introduced as 'it is suggested'.

rules.title: Breakdown: move off the pavement
rules.when: the vehicle breaks down on a HIGHWAY
rules.action: move the car off the pavement to the side of the road
rules.unless: the car cannot be moved off the road
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle breaks down on a HIGHWAY, the DRIVER MUST move the car off the pavement to the side of the road, UNLESS the car cannot be moved off the road.
rules.note: 10.52 adds that a car with a flat tire or blowout can be driven slowly off the road; 10.51 covers the case where the car cannot be moved (get everyone out and off the road, use portable warning devices).

rules.title: Breakdown: warning lights
rules.when: the vehicle is stopped on or beside a HIGHWAY because of a breakdown
rules.action: turn on the emergency warning lights, or the taillights if there are no warning lights, and at night also turn on the lights inside the car
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is stopped on or beside a HIGHWAY because of a breakdown, the DRIVER MUST turn on the emergency warning lights, or the taillights if there are no warning lights, and at night also turn on the lights inside the car.

rules.title: No motor running in a garage
rules.when: the vehicle is in a garage
rules.action: leave the motor running
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is in a garage, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave the motor running.
rules.note: Reason given: carbon monoxide poisoning.

rules.title: Parked with motor running and windows closed
rules.when: the car is parked
rules.action: leave the motor running with the windows closed
rules.statement: WHEN the car is parked, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave the motor running with the windows closed.
rules.note: Reason given: carbon monoxide poisoning.

rules.title: Heater or air conditioner in an enclosed space
rules.when: the car is parked in an enclosed space with the windows closed
rules.action: use the heater or air conditioner
rules.statement: WHEN the car is parked in an enclosed space with the windows closed, the DRIVER MUST NOT use the heater or air conditioner.
rules.note: Reason given: carbon monoxide poisoning.

rules.title: Bicycle parking on a sidewalk
rules.when: the bicycle does not impede the normal and reasonable movement of pedestrian or other traffic on the sidewalk
rules.action: stop, stand or park the bicycle on a sidewalk
rules.statement: WHEN the bicycle does not impede the normal and reasonable movement of pedestrian or other traffic on the sidewalk, the CYCLIST MAY ONLY stop, stand or park the bicycle on a sidewalk.

vague_terms.explanation: what counts as impeding is not defined

rules.note: Listed oddly under parking on a highway outside an urban area. MAY ONLY reads as: allowed on the sidewalk only when it does not impede traffic.
